flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/{list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx,hook/ApplyOperationAction.tsx} (notice select checkbox and TS/PS/REVIVAL/CPS/PAY batch operations). No AOS code in the six repos
note: The Notice Search result list has checkboxes to select notices, but the available batch actions are only TS, PS, REVIVAL, CPS and PAY (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:152-215). There is no 'add to AOS' action, no AOS entity/table and no endpoint to save a summons list into an AOS. The story status is blank in the data. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the selection checkboxes in the Notice Search list exist; adding summonses to an AOS and storing an AOS are not in the repo.

steps.step: Officer selects summonses from the search results
steps.detail: The Notice Search result list supports selecting one row or all rows via checkbox (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:122-128). That is a generic notice selection mechanism, not summons selection for an AOS, and the OCMS31.1 search results are only general notices.

steps.step: Officer adds the selected summonses to the AOS
steps.detail: The actions available on selected notices are only TS, PS, REVIVAL, CPS and PAY (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:152, 176, 200, 209, 214). There is no AOS action. Case-insensitive grep across the six repos for affidavit, aos, oath, commissioner, registered article, date served, designation, e-sign: no relevant hit in the UI or the API (ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi).

steps.step: The system stores the summons list added to the AOS
steps.detail: There is no AOS entity, repository or endpoint in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi. The only court entity in crud/ocmsizdb is ocms_court_case with notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:18-31), unrelated to the AOS. steps.step: The summons details are shown in the AOS
steps.detail: There is no AOS document or view that reads summonses.
